blocks.text: We are a few weeks into the program now, so I am starting this thread as the one place for status and approvals on the {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}} work, which should mean you have a single message to answer instead of several separate ones from Laura, Michelle and me. I have attached version 3 of the kickoff memo, which includes the changes you asked for to the order of the work and to who leads each part.

On progress, Michelle has finished a first pass at the shareholder and analyst baseline from public sources, Laura has a draft interview guide ready for you that follows the structure we discussed, and I have a rough outline of the narrative that I am holding back until the interviews give us something to test it against. Michelle's work already points to a few gaps in the register that are worth discussing, and I would like to go through those with you once the transfer agent's data lets us confirm them.

To keep the interviews on schedule, could you send us (1) the most recent shareholder register or ownership report from your transfer agent, since the public filings only show part of the picture, and (2) your approval of the proposed interviewee list Laura sent last week, with any names you would like added or removed? Once we have both, Laura will start booking the first conversations.
